title: Oasis Island
description: Oasis Island: a side mode unlocked at Town Center level 19 where you develop an island to earn permanent buffs for your main account (combat stats, squad capacity, march speed, and economy/growth boosts). Acts as a second development/tech layer (see knowledge/research.json -> research-speed-boosts).

entries.name: Core gameplay loop (Essence & Prosperity)
entries.summary: Unlocked at Town Center level 19. Loop: accumulate Essence -> upgrade Fountain of Life and Reservoirs -> higher Essence generation. Upgrading the Fountain requires reaching Prosperity thresholds, gained by constructing buildings/decorations.

essence.role: The upgrade currency. Used to upgrade the Fountain of Life and Reservoirs, which raise Essence generation rate.
gained_by: Passively from the Fountain of Life and Reservoirs.
Finding treasure chests hidden in cacti.

prosperity.role: A measure of island development; gates Fountain upgrades (must reach thresholds).
prosperity.key_trait: NOT consumed on use — it is a cumulative total gained by constructing buildings and decorations.

details.second_tech_tree_note: At Fountain Level 10, Oasis buildings act as a second tech tree; archetype research priorities apply (see knowledge/research.json -> research-speed-boosts).

entries.name: Building & decoration types
entries.summary: Island items fall into distinct buff categories. Only some provide gameplay buffs; others are cosmetic or prosperity-only.

types.prosperity_only: Increase Prosperity total but give no other buff.
types.growth_oriented: Bonuses to mainland activities: research, construction, gathering speed.
types.limited_time: Powerful event-exclusive buildings with unique/significant buffs (example: 'Golden Sunset' lighthouse boosting troop health and lethality).

details.buffs_scope: Buffs apply to the MAIN account (combat stats, squad capacity, march speed, economy/growth).
details.max_active_rule: You only receive bonuses for the maximum number of active buildings ALLOWED of a type — extra copies waste Essence.

entries.name: Seven tips for accelerated growth
entries.summary: Practical optimization tips for faster Essence/Prosperity and efficient layout.

tips: Reservoir placement: position reservoirs near cacti with treasure chests to clear them faster.
Strategic decorations: use cosmetic decorations to block worker paths and guide workers toward desired cacti.
Value-dense items: prioritize decorations with more Prosperity per square to conserve space.
Buy cheaper decorations first: complete a quest line that rewards extra Essence.
Recycle items: recycle for half their cost for a quick Essence boost or to free space.
Upgrade Reservoirs quickly: reach Reservoir level 4 ASAP for a SECOND worker (doubles clearing speed).
Identify arbitrage: watch each item's Essence-to-Prosperity ratio for the most efficient purchases.
common_mistakes: Building too many of the same item (only max active buildings give bonuses — extras waste Essence).
Excessive early decoration (drains resources needed by the main town and clutters the island).
Inefficient worker pathing (pretty layouts that stop workers reaching treasure chests quickly).

open_questions: Exact Essence/Prosperity numbers per Fountain/Reservoir level and per building are not captured (only the loop and item categories).
